Tomba 2 Widescreen

Enable this feature on the Mods page, then choose 16:9, 21:9, or Adaptive.
Adaptive follows the live window from the original 4:3 up to 21:9.

The mod activates Tomba 2's native-wide projection, overlay culling, backdrop,
and resident-object participation hooks. BIOS, FMVs, and true 2D screens remain
at their authored 4:3 aspect.
